0.0: Heeey, always good to meet a new friend! #h0#,\r\nwas it? From the looks of it, I'll bet YOU would be sympathetic to the plight of a completely innocent man. Am I right?

yes.0: I've had it hard ever since my last, erm, business went belly up, but it wasn't my fault! Rumors travel fast, true or not, and once everybody thought I was trying to scam them, I was done for. But I swear I wasn't! Everything was completely legitimate! It was just bad press!
yes.1: But I'm taking a whole new approach to business now. You see, I noticed the #b#o9400401##k were hanging around the castle... and if I know anything, I know they carry #b#t04000338#s#k.
yes.2: The poison they use on those #b#t04000338#s#k is top-quality product, and they're so careless with it. I shudder to think what would happen if one of our sweet, innocent children got hurt... If you get me 100 of those\r\n#b#t04000338#s#k, it would go a long way to keeping our dear children safe.

no.0: Guess I'll just have to find somebody else who wants to make a lot of money for very little effort...

1.0: Very nice. Very nice indeed. Think how many children we saved...
1.1: Now, we don't want to go around bragging about our good deeds, do we? No, no we don't need the attention. Just keep this between us. A good deed between completely altruistic friends...

item.0: I told you I needed 100 #b#t04000338#s#k! I can't have any less. Hurry it up before I get... B-before any children get hurt!
